scope: ERC20 precise approval/reset confirmation, durable pre-dispatch journal, original/speedup/cancellation hash read-only receipt recovery. Actual deposit submission and credit recovery remain unavailable.

journal.coverage: Host file rebuild, exact public-only immutable terms, bounded lexical codec/tamper checks, duplicate wallet guard, corruption/temp preservation, failed locating/reading/writing after reported hash retain it in memory and reload merges it.

receipt.coverage: Mock RPC only: exact original/speedup transaction binding, wrong wallet/chain/nonce/hash, pending/missing/one-confirmation, canonical success/revert, same-nonce changed-intent replacement/cancellation/creation, freshness/reorg, exact legacy/effective fee and no broadcasts.

controller.coverage: Explicit EOA review, no wallet creation, reset-only and no deposit/native dispatch; fresh re-estimate drift/expiry, persistence before request, rejection/known-not-sent vs unknown, duplicate/stop/logout/disposal, hash and recovery isolation, invalid terminal proof, restored read-only EOA and actual host file pre-send/rebuild.

widget.coverage: English/Chinese 320 width at 1.5 text, landscape and tablet; precise/reset review and spender, cancel/input retention, confirm, one send only, recovery candidate hash, failure/scroll/stop retention and wallet isolation.

acceptance_evidence.full_regression: All 2024 tests pass, including existing auth/funding/portfolio/bilingual widgets. Final test-only brace formatting followed by controller rerun; production code unchanged after full run/build.

build_notes: Existing third-party Kotlin migration notices; build successful. No installation.
ios: Linux has no macOS/Xcode; not built or natively verified.
native_testing: Not performed at user request; no device tools or APK installation. See ../native-verification-pending.md.
